name: libxsmm-k-loop-joint-two-stream-end-tests
hypothesis: Replace the countdown in Llibxsmm_478 and Llibxsmm_70c with joint two-stream termination checks. Caller-saved x4 and x5 hold the initial B pointer plus 1048576 bytes and packed-A pointer plus 131072 bytes. CMP and conditional CCMP continue only while both pointers differ from their ends. With the unchanged strides, both reach their ends after exactly 512 ordered FP32 updates, including the second row half. No additional demand loads occur. This implements the selected joint check, distinct from the historical separate single-stream checks. It does not establish reduced instruction cost or a speedup. Pointer rewinds, traversal, packing, SME transitions, general-size fallback, n<=0 behavior, unused helper and both complete license notices remain unchanged. No tools or tests were run. Compilation, full-GEMM correctness and fresh repeated paired performance validation remain required under the unchanged gates and initial power settings. Throughput above 1800 GFLOP/s is not established.
